critical_steps: For right composition Lambda_j O, the synthesis operator is O-star T_Lambda.
For an original dual pair, the transformed mixed operator is exactly O_2-star O_1.
Choosing both operators as the backward shift satisfies the published condition O_2 O_1-star=I.
The transformed coordinate family omits the first coordinate and has zero coefficient energy at e_1.
Replacing the published operator product by O_2-star O_1 gives necessary and sufficient exact and approximate transport criteria.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact synthesis-operator calculation and the unilateral shift on l2.
integrity.unproved_limits: No claim is made about unrelated stability theorems or about the absence of nonindexed corrections.

scientific_limitations: The finding corrects Theorem 3.1 only and does not reassess later characterization or perturbation theorems in the article.
The exact-branch counterexample is infinite-dimensional; in finite dimension the source one-sided inverse condition collapses to invertibility and the reversed condition also holds.
Full text of some older and later comparison papers was not available in the bounded literature check, so an unindexed or inaccessible prior correction remains a residual risk.
title: Adjoints reverse the operator transport condition for dual \(g\)-frames
